title: Sentiment Analysis on Customer Reviews — WeLoveReviews
description: Start from the machine-learning-python-template: run the EDA prompt in `src/explore.ipynb`, integrate `nlptown/bert-base-multilingual-uncased-sentiment` in `src/app.py`, export a processed CSV with sentiment labels, find false negatives from product-vs-service domain mismatch, and compare sentiment breakdown against a 4.5-star average.
